problem: A stale or superseded PR can be replaced by a functionally equivalent successor while silently losing a small but important workflow, classifier, test-registration, documentation or governance delta.
root_cause: Successor validation compared implementation intent and broad file content, but did not require a machine-checkable old-versus-successor coverage audit across executable tests, workflow registrations and governance metadata before declaring the predecessor fully superseded.
prevention: SUCCESSOR_COMPLETENESS_IS_DELTA_BASED: before closing or deleting a predecessor lineage, compare predecessor and successor changed-file sets plus executable-test/workflow/classifier/governance deltas.
NO_ORPHAN_EXECUTABLE_TESTS: every executable regression test introduced by a predecessor must remain registered in an applicable canonical workflow or be explicitly retired with evidence.
SUPERSEDES_REQUIRES_COVERAGE_PROOF: an explicit Supersedes relation is not sufficient by itself; successor acceptance must prove retained functional, regression, workflow and governance coverage.
SQUASH_ANCESTRY_IS_NOT_COMPLETENESS: branch divergence or non-ancestry after squash merge is not evidence of missing or present content; compare semantic/file coverage instead.
BRANCH_CLEANUP_REQUIRES_SUCCESSOR_PROOF: delete historical branches only after merged-successor/main containment and coverage-integrity proof are both established.
COVERAGE_GAP_IS_RECOVERABLE_INCOMPLETE: if any predecessor-only required delta is found, keep the obligation open and repair it through the current canonical lineage before terminal completion.
